title: Person of Christ
definition: The doctrine of the person of Christ teaches that Jesus Christ is one divine Person, the eternal Son of God, who took to Himself a true human nature without ceasing to be fully God.
summary: Jesus is not partly God and partly man, but truly God and truly man in one Person. This truth protects both His saving power and His compassionate nearness to us.
christFocus: In Christ, God has come near. The Savior who redeems us is fully able to save because He is God, and fully able to represent us because He became truly man.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The eternal Son did not begin at Bethlehem; He took on flesh at Bethlehem.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: His two natures are united in one Person without confusion, division, or loss.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Because He is God, His work has infinite worth; because He is man, He stands as the true representative of His people.
